items.title: Eddie Miller and Pete Fountain Interview, 1970-01-09
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] So, again, congratulations to Eddie Miller, Pete, you, everybody on the program. [INTERVIEWEE] I think he went at the Broadwater years ago. Years ago. Right.

ctx.x: Yeah, I didn't recognize your voice at first. I know everybody over there. I don't think I've met you. Talking about Leon Keller, it's been about 26 or 27 years in the Blue Room. Used to be around the Gulf Coast, Biloxi. You know, in between. You know, the four years.
I think he went at the Broadwater years ago. Years ago. Right.
